description: Same-binary 256 versus 512 row staged P2P chunk prefill on RTX 3060 and 3080; single-order experiment, not long-context qualification.
method: Same server binary, model and environment except Q36_P2P_CHUNK: control 256 then candidate 512. Each arm had one cold 64-token warmup, three cold 524-token prompts, three cold 4274-token prompts, and three deterministic 128-token decode samples. Server job-start-to-first-token timing includes first-token generation; client timing includes the complete reply. Server and client counts, zero reuse, successful responses, correct arithmetic answers, decode output hashes and finish reasons were checked.

memory_reference.note: 256 MiB is a planning allowance, not a measured upper bound for the 512-row allocation; the new server must also pass its own admission and the 1 GiB live guard.

short.timing_note: Server timing runs from job start to first emitted batch and includes first-token generation; client timing runs to the complete reply.

long.timing_note: Server timing runs from job start to first emitted batch and includes first-token generation; client timing runs to the complete reply.

limits: The measured server is the parent integration commit; this MR adds test-only code and evidence.
One control-then-candidate order with three samples per arm; order and thermal effects were not crossed over.
The model was configured for a 262144-token context, but the longest prompt was 4274 tokens; no 128k/256k recall, coding quality, or long-session qualification.
Both arms used the experimental chunk path, which disables prefix reuse; neither arm represents the live eager service.
The 512-row physical-peer parity fixture used two synthetic layers and checked only final greedy winner and top-two logits; matching short served replies is not a general quality test.
The guard sampled VRAM and activity; sampled floors cannot exclude an unsampled transient. The confirmed router-poll exception cannot prove no hidden user request.
The candidate is not enabled or deployed by this change.
